symptom.error: directed-effect dispatch and abort call ids must partition the prepared inventory

root_cause.detail: The authoritative policy guard soft-denies individual deferred repair members and TaskRuntime seals only authorized candidates into the DEO parent. The deferred follow-up executor nevertheless forwarded the original pre-policy forward/rollback call-id partition, bindings and dispatch batch to ToolBatchRuntime. The runtime correctly rejected that stale partition before any effect could execute.
not_root_causes: generated target project mutation by the main agent
ToolBatchRuntime partition invariant being too strict

fix.behavior: Project deferred forward ids, rollback ids, effect bindings, rollback activation and dispatch invocations onto the exact prepared DEO inventory. Preserve each forward/rollback repair pair atomically; a partially prepared pair fails closed with a specific audited error instead of leaking a generic partition ValueError.
preserved_guards: ToolBatchRuntime still requires dispatch plus abort to exactly partition the authoritative prepared parent
forward and rollback call ids remain disjoint and unique
rollback activation remains bound to its prepared forward

verification.red_test: production-shaped two-repair follow-up failed because four original ids were passed to a two-member prepared parent

remaining_exact_run_failure.next_debug_action: Audit the exact same-task repair provider request, normalized edit arguments, policy denial evidence and post-repair verifier frontier before any additional platform edit.
